court: Court of Cassation General Assembly Civil Materials
statutes_or_issues: Customs tariff schedules; WTO agreement effective 1 Jan 1995; phased tariff reductions
public_headnote: Reduced customs tariff under WTO agreement and supplementary schedules applies from 1 Jan 1995 according to the phased timetable; full application after five years from the final date in the schedules; General Assembly adopts this principle and departs from contrary prior rulings
source_status: Public official homepage headnote; Technical Office 73
limitations: Full judgment text and underlying facts not public in this summary; advanced full text is subscription-restricted

court: Court of Cassation General Assembly Civil Materials
statutes_or_issues: Employment contract termination; worker duty to maintain dignity of work and proper conduct; final criminal conviction outside workplace
public_headnote: Employer may terminate employment where evidence establishes worker breach of duty to maintain dignity of work and proper conduct and a final criminal judgment convicts the worker of a felony or misdemeanour involving honour trust or public morals outside the workplace; General Assembly adopts principle and departs from contrary prior view
source_status: Public official homepage headnote; Technical Office 73
limitations: Headnote only; full judgment and exact statutory article not retrieved

statutes_or_issues: Transfer of employee; unused annual leave; cash compensation
public_headnote: Transfer of an employee does not terminate the former employer's obligation to pay cash compensation for unused leave that the employee could not use for a reason attributable to that employer; former employer remains responsible for breach of a statutory obligation
source_status: Public official homepage headnote; Technical Office 75
limitations: Portal places the headnote in the General Assembly list; full judgment text subscription-restricted

statutes_or_issues: Law79/1975 Arts52 and56; multiple work injuries; disability exceeding35%
public_headnote: Where an employee sustained two injuries with disability exceeding35% and the record does not show prior injury pension or lump-sum compensation or that injury caused termination,  the employee is entitled to an injury pension under Articles52 and56 of Law79/1975; contrary judgment is defective
source_status: Public official homepage headnote; Technical Office 75
limitations: Law79/1975 is historical after Law148/2019; preserve period and transition analysis; headnote only

court: Court of Cassation General Assembly Civil Materials
statutes_or_issues: Customs Law66/1963 Art111; invalidated ministerial customs service fees; ordinary court jurisdiction
public_headnote: Claim to recover customs service fees collected without right on release of goods under Article111 of Customs Law66/1963 and ministerial decisions declared unconstitutional is a civil dispute within ordinary courts' general jurisdiction; General Assembly adopts this view and departs from contrary rulings
source_status: Public official homepage headnote; Technical Office 70
limitations: Customs Law66/1963 is repealed by Law207/2020; headnote relates historical collections and jurisdiction; full judgment restricted

statutes_or_issues: Civil Code Art232; current account interest; interest-on-interest custom
public_headnote: Where a bank closes a current account and fails to prove a custom permitting interest to exceed the principal debt,  it must comply with the prohibition in Civil Code Article232; judgment applying this rule is correct
source_status: Public official homepage headnote; Technical Office 75
limitations: Headnote only; full reasoning and account facts unavailable

statutes_or_issues: Commercial pledge; sale of pledged business assets; bankruptcy trustee joinder
public_headnote: A judgment authorizing sale of components of a commercially pledged business without joining the bankruptcy trustee cannot be asserted against the bankruptcy estate; General Assembly adopts the principle and departs from contrary rulings
source_status: Public official homepage headnote; Technical Office 75
limitations: Headnote only; verify exact procedural instrument and bankruptcy statute version

statutes_or_issues: New lease contract; termination of previous relationship; evidentiary duty
public_headnote: Where the tenant asserts a new lease and submits the original contract showing agreement to end the prior lease and consensual return of the premises,  the defence is material; ignoring it and treating the later contract as a statutory extension is a defect in reasoning and evidentiary examination
source_status: Public official homepage headnote; Technical Office 75
limitations: Headnote only; exact rent-law temporal regime must be checked

statutes_or_issues: Criminal Procedure Law Art419 bis(3) added by Law1/2024; summary report in appeals
public_headnote: Requirement to prepare/read a case summary report applies to appealed misdemeanour courts and not felony courts; addition of Article419 bis(3) by Law1/2024 requiring felony appeal courts to follow misdemeanour appeal procedures does not change that conclusion
source_status: Public official homepage headnote; Technical Office 75
limitations: Headnote only; verify exact statutory text and procedural version at relevant date

public_headnote: If the challenged judgment ends in acquittal of the convicted person,  the prosecution's appeal is rejected
source_status: Public official homepage headnote; Technical Office 75
limitations: Headnote only; procedural context not supplied

statutes_or_issues: Embezzled funds; administrative expenses added to restitution
public_headnote: Adding administrative expenses to the value of embezzled funds as a criminal restitution amount is an error in applying the law and requires correction
source_status: Public official homepage headnote; Technical Office 75
limitations: Headnote only; exact offense and statutory basis require full judgment

statutes_or_issues: Police surveillance ancillary penalty; omission by trial court
public_headnote: Failure to impose police surveillance where legally required is an error of law,  but the Court of Cassation cannot correct it in the circumstances stated in the headnote
source_status: Public official homepage headnote; Technical Office 75
limitations: Headnote only; full disposition and statutory basis not retrieved

statutes_or_issues: Threat to disclose matters damaging to honour; extortion; aggravated imprisonment
public_headnote: Imposing three years' aggravated imprisonment for threatening to disclose matters damaging to honour accompanied by a demand under the more serious offence description was an error in applying the law requiring correction
source_status: Public official homepage headnote; Technical Office 75
limitations: Headnote only; exact statutory provisions and disposition unavailable

statutes_or_issues: Embezzlement; loan for use; intent to appropriate
public_headnote: Embezzlement is established where the accused develops intent to appropriate movable property delivered as a loan for use and fails to return it; the portal gives an example of conviction and civil compensation
source_status: Public official homepage headnote; Technical Office 75
limitations: Headnote only; exact case number format and underlying judgment require confirmation

statutes_or_issues: Request to retract a Court of Cassation judgment; standing
public_headnote: Request to retract a Court of Cassation judgment requires the applicant to have been a party to that judgment; a civil claimant who was not a party to the relevant appeal lacks standing
source_status: Public official homepage headnote; Technical Office 68

statutes_or_issues: Inherited compensation; res judicata; heirs not represented in earlier case
public_headnote: Once inherited compensation has been established and assessed by a final judgment,  the assessment cannot be reopened; an heir not represented in that judgment cannot separately claim the same inherited compensation
source_status: Public official homepage headnote; Technical Office 64
limitations: Older principle; exact parties and scope require full judgment

statutes_or_issues: Family Courts Law10/2004 Art3; permission to marry
public_headnote: Family Courts have jurisdiction over all personal-status matters under Article3 of Law10/2004,  including a claim for permission to marry
source_status: Public official homepage headnote; Technical Office 67

court: Court of Cassation General Assembly Civil Materials
statutes_or_issues: Family Courts Law10/2004; enforcement of foreign judgments
public_headnote: Family Courts Law10/2004 established an integrated jurisdiction but does not confer jurisdiction to grant exequatur to foreign judgments; that application remains within ordinary courts
source_status: Public official homepage headnote; date not shown in captured summary
